modules.name: lfm3lab
modules.overview: Lightweight compatibility namespace. Exposes __version__; use submodules, not root model-loading shortcuts.
modules.docstring:
Glass-Box compatibility namespace. Importing it loads no numerical stack.

Use lfm3lab.glassbox for instruments and lfm3lab.research for fixed studies.
Unrelated archive helpers and root-level model-loading shortcuts are not exported.

modules.name: lfm3lab.research
modules.overview: Convenience imports for protocols, sessions, study execution and reports. All imports are model-free.
modules.docstring: Reproducible mechanistic research. No model loading at import time.

modules.name: lfm3lab.research.backends
modules.overview: Initial pinned LFM3 adapter, not general model support. Construction/status load no weights. The first valid run lazily loads a model and retains the lifetime lock until close. CPU/MPS loading requires an additional opt-in.
modules.docstring:
Lazy, serialized adapter for the verified LFM3-1.7B Glass-Box primitives.

This module adds no eager torch/model-loader imports and status loads no weights.
The Glass-Box root initializer likewise loads no numerical dependencies.
The adapter owns every model it loads, and holds the process inference lock until
close has released the weights and caches. Public primitives remain unchanged.

symbols.name: lfm3lab.research.backends.LFM3Backend
symbols.summary: One lazy, mutex-serialized initial LFM3 instruct adapter.
symbols.docstring:
One lazily loaded pinned instruct checkpoint, not an arbitrary LFM family.

All calls, including status and close, serialize on a thread mutex. CPU/MPS
weight loading is refused unless allow_local_model=True; CUDA is permitted.
Explicit full commit revisions are required for stable unloaded/loaded IDs.

contract.summary: One lazy, mutex-serialized initial LFM3 instruct adapter.
contract.notes: device: cuda/cuda:N/cpu/mps; cuda becomes cuda:0. dtype: bfloat16/float32/float16, optional torch. prefix. revision must be an explicit 40-hex commit; only PINNED is marked verified. status exposes runtime versions and numerical source hashes. close releases loaded weights before dropping the lifetime lock.

symbols.summary: Execute each unstarted case × condition pair in one explicitly named split.
symbols.docstring:
Never retries a started pair; budgets apply across all explicit splits.

Time limits prevent starting another call, not interrupting an in-flight
backend operation. Interrupted calls consume their remaining reservation.

contract.summary: Execute each unstarted case × condition pair in one explicitly named split.

modules.name: lfm3lab.glassbox
modules.overview: PyTorch instruments and native coordinates. Direct primitives require caller-owned Loaded model and inference_lock throughout load/use/unload. Do not overlap hook contexts. Low-level helpers are documented for completeness, not as a general adapter API.
modules.docstring:
Standalone LFM3 mechanistic primitives. No router dependencies or presets.

All positions refer to predictor tokens, not the tokens being predicted. Public
functions accept a Loaded model; its owner must hold inference_lock for the whole
load/use/unload lifetime and serialize hooks. DLA is a frozen-final-norm direct
 projection, not a downstream causal effect. See docs/library-guide.md.

Head score: sum_d z_d*dmargin/dz_d, with z=g*attention, algebraically

Inspected-position and per-position head arrays are also returned.

modules.name: lfm3lab.research.worker
modules.overview: Advanced JSON transport. Connects to existing hardware, never provisions it. Remote close closes only the proxy. Server owners must shutdown, drain server_close, then close the backend. Use SSH/TLS and authentication as appropriate; not a multi-tenant production service.
modules.docstring:
JSON-only, serialized research transport. The server does not own its backend.

Call shutdown() from another thread, then server_close(), before backend.close().
Socket and queue timeouts bound waiting, not an already-running model operation.
For nonloopback deployment use TLS at a trusted reverse proxy or an SSH tunnel.

modules.overview: Installed glass-box CLI implementation; lfm3-research is a compatibility alias. Prefer the command-line interface over parser internals. check requires the instruments extra; examples/validate/report are dependency-free.
modules.docstring:
Model-free defaults and explicit local/remote execution for fixed studies.

Run exits: 0 = requested split complete (including zero cases), 1 = failed or
interrupted trials / command error, 3 = incomplete with missing trials. Failed
or interrupted trials take precedence over missing trials. Reports remain JSON
on stdout; the model-free report command exits 0 even for partial/failed studies.
